findings.title: Default output beside the root deletes hand-authored files under .agents/ and .pi/ on rebuild
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: a build now swaps only each harness's packs folder and marketplace manifest, read from `HarnessProfile::owned_paths`, so a hand-added `.agents/skills/mine/SKILL.md` survives a rebuild (regression tests in core and the CLI). The docs say those paths are generated output, replaced on every build. Separately, by owner decision, `--out` or `build.out` is now required, so there is no default output beside the root.

findings.title: Walk-up skips marketplaces/skillwright/skillwright.md, a workspace member root
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: `marketplaces` no longer counts as a kind folder in this test, so `marketplaces/skillwright/skillwright.md` is a root file; test added.

findings.title:
Vault walk reads plugins/

/assets/ as notes; a described .md there refuses the build
findings.reason:
Fixed in 2a38548: every vault walk now leaves out `plugins/

/assets/`, so a described `.md` there is not read as a note; test added.

findings.title: docs exclusion also drops assets/docs/ from plugin assets
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: the convention's `assets/` folder now lands whole with no filter, and `build.assets` directories use a new list without `docs`; `docs` stays excluded only for skill bundles.

findings.title: adopt (and bump, new) run at a workspace root; adopt writes notes no member builds
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: `adopt`, `bump` and every `new`/authoring verb (rename, move, delete, convert too) now call `refuse_workspace`; the CLI test covers them.

findings.title: Workspace inherits build keys outside the Decided inherit list
findings.reason: Declined: the decided design says the workspace root holds shared defaults and the `build:` settings for its members, and the inherit list governs frontmatter fields moving down notes, not a workspace's `build:` block. A member's own `build:` value already overrides key by key; that now has a test and is documented in the `inherit` doc and the README.

findings.title: parse_root_file is not exposed through wasm; spec wants one reader for CLI and wasm
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: wasm exports `parseRootFile` (text in, `RootFile` out) and `rootFileConfig` (text and folder name in, `MarketplaceConfig` out, with the name default); `RootFile` and `BuildSettings` are in both `core.generated.ts` copies. There was no wasm-side reader of the old file to remove. `rootFileConfig` returns a JS object because the generator cannot spell `MarketplaceConfig` as both request and response.

findings.title: CHANGELOG version check is a substring match; 11.0.0 satisfies 1.0.0
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: the heading check now compares whole tokens, with an optional leading `v`; `## 11.0.0` and `## 1.0.0-rc.1` no longer satisfy `1.0.0`; test added.

findings.title: CHANGELOG check skipped for a plugin with no note (default 0.1.0)
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: a plugin with no stated version is checked at the version it ships, `DEFAULT_PLUGIN_VERSION` (`0.1.0`); test added.

findings.title: watch ignores every dot folder at the top of out, including build.hooks sources there
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548: `watch` now ignores only what a build writes (`built_paths`: packs, manifests, the stage), so a `build.hooks` source under `.claude/` triggers a rebuild; test added.

findings.title: Zero-config detection does not walk up; a run from plugins/p/skills says No vault
findings.reason: Fixed in 2a38548 with the simpler option: the message now says a vault with no `skillwright.md` is found only from its own root. A walk-up could silently pick an unrelated ancestor that holds `skills/`, and a build would then write there.

findings.title: Stale marketplace.* key names left in messages and docs
findings.reason: Replaced the removed marketplace.* names with build.out.
